published_failure_contract: JMockit 1.42 requires JVM startup with -javaagent. The target modules do not supply it; TestNG setup reports an uninitialized agent and dependent tests produce NullPointerException.

source_isolation.evidence: The first commit makes TestNG verify initialization instead of attempting attachment; the second removes general Attach API loading and introduces the exact -javaagent diagnostic. The release cannot be represented honestly as one version-only commit.

a1_input.evidence: All published methods exist throughout this mainline window and OAuth2PlatformClientTest.setup is at the recorded line 69. The following commit moves the statement to line 67. The workbook does not select one commit within the window.

target_history.evidence: Across all 499 commits reachable from remote refs, 235 unique POM blobs for the three modules contain no JMockit 1.42 and no -javaagent setting. Maintainers reverted newer JMockit attempts to 1.25; no commit preserves 1.42 and restores the published tests.

stop_reason: The three module records are one root relation, the exact target revision is absent, and the complete maintainer history has no A2 under JMockit 1.42. A hand-authored Surefire agent configuration would be a synthetic repair.
